claims.claim: Section 5(a)(2): for a company in the 20% route, section 81B(b)(2) (the 50% escape) is read with the words 'less the profits remaining from the profits at the end of tax year 2024' appended, that quantity being the company's excess profits at the end of 2024 less profits already distributed to shareholders as taxed dividends. The denominator of the 50% test is therefore reduced.

claims.claim: A profit-holding holder (machzik baal revachim) is a holder for whom, ACROSS ALL COMPANIES in which he is a substantial holder, TOGETHER, accumulated profits as defined in section 77(a) at the end of the preceding tax year did not exceed NIS 750 thousand. The test therefore aggregates across companies rather than applying per company.
